body:
Real launcher icon (all density buckets), explicit minSdkVersion/targetSdkVersion, real versionCode/versionName wiring, live scan-progress indicator. New .github/workflows/ci.yml mirroring PARENA's own auto-release scheme: build_and_test on every push/PR, release job (main only) computes next minor version, sed-patches it into app/BUILD.bazel, rebuilds, tags, and cuts a real GitHub Release with the signed APK. Live-verified the sed-patch+rebuild logic locally before committing -- produced a real versionCode=42/versionName=v0.1.0 APK, confirmed via aapt2 dump badging + apksigner verify.

⚓ ☃
title: Product-completeness pass + real auto-releases (CI/CD)
